bench:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable standalone bench game sprite on a genuinely transparent background.
Input images: Image 1 is only a style and wood palette reference for an existing cozy farming village, not an edit target.
Primary request: Draw a simple new village wooden bench with a backrest, a comfortable seat, two supports and understated armrests. Warm honey-brown wood, dark brown supports, softly bevelled plank edges, broad clean shading and very restrained wood grain. Keep readable at 120 pixels wide.
Composition: Isolated whole object, centered, ample transparent padding, front view with a modest elevated top-down view showing the seat, matching the village buildings' camera. Width roughly twice height. Bench horizontal, flat across the image, no diagonal rotation. Square high-resolution source.
Style: Clean hand-painted game sprite, smooth contour, small neat outline, simple shapes. Match the charming fantasy world while reducing coarse pixel clusters and visual noise.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha, no scenery, no ground plane, no grass, no people, no text, no watermark. All legs fully visible. Small soft contact shadow only under feet.
Avoid: coarse pixel art, photorealistic render, ornate metalwork, engraved patterns, chunky black outline, clipping.
lilies:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable floating water-lily cluster game sprite on a genuinely transparent background.
Input images: Image 1 is a palette and style reference for a cozy farming-game river only, not an edit target.
Primary request: A compact cluster of five lily pads, rounded fresh green leaves with a small V-shaped notch, one small cream-white water lily with a warm yellow center. A few subtle dark green leaf veins; restrained shadow under each leaf. Mostly broad calm shapes. Readable at 70 by 45 game pixels.
Composition: Isolated horizontal oval cluster, viewed orthographically from above, complete shape with generous transparent padding. Square high-resolution source.
Style: Simple clean hand-painted fantasy game sprite with smooth contours, consistent with the village and quieter than coarse pixel art.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha between and around the leaves, no blue water background, no ground, no rocks, no tall reeds, no tree foliage, no text or watermark.
Avoid: dense bouquet, many flowers, photorealism, coarse pixels, harsh outlines, large detailed reflection.
railing:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable riverside safety-railing parts sprite sheet for a cozy fantasy farming village.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and wood palette reference only, not an edit target.
Primary request: Create exactly two separated reusable railing parts, in two equal square cells side by side, on a genuinely transparent canvas. LEFT CELL: one sturdy vertical warm-brown wooden post with a simple pale wooden cap and a small grey stone foot, viewed from the front with a slight elevated village-game camera. RIGHT CELL: one straight horizontal timber rail, long and slender with a softly bevelled top, a clean honey-brown front face and simple dark lower edge; no support posts attached. These two parts will be assembled into a waist-high two-rail riverbank fence by the game engine.
Composition: Strict 2-column by 1-row sprite sheet, each part isolated and centered in its cell, at least 12 percent transparent padding on all sides. Post upright vertically, rail horizontal across its cell. Wide landscape source 2048 by 1024.
Style: Simple clean hand-painted game props, broad shading, smooth contours, very restrained wood grain, matching the village bridges. Less coarse and more readable than pixelated fence art.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha, no complete fence, no scenery, no labels, no cell outlines, no background, no grass, no ropes, no ornate carvings, no watermark. Do not touch the cell boundary. Both parts use the exact same material and lighting.
Avoid: thick black outlines, highly detailed grain, pixel noise, photorealism, decorative finials, checkerboard background.
